blocks.lead: Building production-oriented 3D generative AI and neural rendering systems.

blocks.title: About
blocks.introHtml: Hi, I'm Hwan Heo (허환), an AI Researcher focused on 3D generative models, neural rendering, and production-oriented 3D asset creation. By day, I build 3D worlds with AI; by night, I'm usually wandering through music, guitar, or random STEM rabbit holes. This site is where I collect the work, notes, and experiments behind that mix.
blocks.bodyHtml: I am an AI Researcher at NC AI, where I lead the research efforts for the VARCO 3D team. My work focuses on training large-scale 3D generative models and setting the technical direction for our key projects in 3D AI Service. I hold both a B.S. and M.S. in Computer Science from Korea University, where I was advised by Professor Hyunwoo J. Kim. Previously, I was a Research Intern at NAVER AI Lab, mentored by Dr. Jin-Hwa Kim.

bulletsHtml: Spearheaded the research and development of core algorithms for VARCO 3D, NC AI's flagship 3D generation service
Led research and development of 3D asset generation, focusing on 3D Latent Diffusion and Texture Synthesis: CaPa
Developed and applied novel Neural Rendering solutions, including:

• Integrated Gaussian Splatting into a proprietary game engine
  • Created a high-speed Neural Facial Avatar for multi-camera systems
Researched a novel neural rendering method using joint optimization of camera poses and hash grid radiance fields
